# design.realized.RealizedDesign { #fmrimod.design.realized.RealizedDesign }

```python
RealizedDesign(matrix, columns, source='user')
```

A named, already-realized design matrix.

``RealizedDesign`` is the typed value for workflows where an external
system has already constructed the design matrix. It composes the existing
`DesignColumns` substrate, rather than carrying a second parallel
metadata shape, so callers can route through `fmrimod.glm.fmri_lm`
without falling back to raw ``(ndarray, columns)`` pairs or private matrix
helpers.

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `column_kinds` | Coarse column roles derived from the typed column records. |
| `column_names` | Column names in realized matrix order. |
| `n_columns` | Number of design columns. |
| `n_timepoints` | Number of rows in the realized design. |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [as_dataframe](#fmrimod.design.realized.RealizedDesign.as_dataframe) | Return the full design matrix with stable column names. |
| [design_columns](#fmrimod.design.realized.RealizedDesign.design_columns) | Return typed column provenance for contrast resolution. |
| [from_array](#fmrimod.design.realized.RealizedDesign.from_array) | Create a realized design from an array and column metadata. |

### as_dataframe { #fmrimod.design.realized.RealizedDesign.as_dataframe }

```python
as_dataframe()
```

Return the full design matrix with stable column names.

### design_columns { #fmrimod.design.realized.RealizedDesign.design_columns }

```python
design_columns()
```

### from_array { #fmrimod.design.realized.RealizedDesign.from_array }

```python
from_array(matrix, columns, kinds=None, source='user')
```
